- [USER] User asked for elaboration on how Ramaphosa has tackled corruption in the government.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] He established the Commission of Inquiry into State Capture in 2018 to investigate allegations of corruption during former President Jacob Zuma's tenure.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ramaphosa's government has strengthened anti-corruption agencies like the Special Investigating Unit and the Hawks.
